# borrow

```go
import "github.com/lucasavila00/immutago/internal/borrow"
```

Package borrow checks shared loans over Go compiler\-resolved storage places. Its conflict, region, liveness, and dataflow algorithms are ports of the pinned rustc implementation. Go\-specific provenance connects pointers to their roots.

## func Check

```go
func Check(pass *analysis.Pass) error
```

Check builds place\-preserving SSA, infers effects to a fixed point, and checks each body. NaiveForm retains addressable variable slots; GlobalDebug retains source expressions.

## func IsStandardLibrary

```go
func IsStandardLibrary(pass *analysis.Pass) bool
```

IsStandardLibrary identifies compiler\-supplied source by its SDK directory. Unavailable standard\-library effects remain unknown; this does not trust pointer calls.

## func Overlap

```go
func Overlap(a, b Place, definite bool) bool
```

Overlap ports rustc's projection comparison with explicit may/must bias. Possible overlap is used for access checks; definite overlap is used for kills. Dereferences are already resolved to canonical allocation roots by the Go adapter.

## func UsesImmutable

```go
func UsesImmutable(pkg *types.Package) bool
```

UsesImmutable reports whether a package can originate marked storage through its import graph.

## type Effect

Effect describes operations on storage reachable from a function input.

```go
type Effect struct{ Read, Write, Capture, Unknown bool }
```

## type Place

Place identifies storage independently of the pointer variables that refer to it. Go aliases are resolved to allocation roots before the rustc comparison runs.

```go
type Place struct {
    Root int
    Path []Projection
}
```

## type Projection

Projection selects a field or an array element within one allocation. Kind is 'f' for a field, 'i' for a constant index, '?' for an unknown index, 'd' for a symbolic dereference, and '\*' for an opaque recursive tail.

```go
type Projection struct {
    Kind  byte
    Index int64
}
```

## type Result

Result describes a returned pointer's source or a fresh allocation.

```go
type Result struct {
    Unknown    bool
    FreshGroup string
    Global     bool
    Input      int
    Fresh      bool
    FreshID    int
    Shared     bool
    Protected  bool
    Path       []Projection
}
```

## type Summary

Summary is a checked function's portable reference\-effect contract.

```go
type Summary struct {
    Unproved bool
    Inputs   []Effect
    Results  [][]Result
}
```
